title: Gigaware USB 2.0 16-Ft Active Extension Cable Gold Plated Connector
categoryName: Computers/Tablets & Networking:Computer Cables & Connectors:USB Cables, Hubs & Adapters
descriptionText:
This Gigaware USB 2.0 Active Extension Cable is a high-quality, 16-ft long cable with a gold-plated connector on both ends. It is compatible with a wide range of devices and has a 1:1 connection split/duplication. The cable is black in color and features a round cable design that is portable and easy to carry. 

This extension cable is perfect for those who need to extend the distance between their USB devices and the computer. It is made in China and has a USB 2.0 connector on both ends, making it compatible with a wide range of devices. The cable is compatible with the plated model and does not come with any custom bundle.
